search_text: published ZDI-17-974 ZDI-CAN-4223 Quest NetVault Backup Server Process Manager Service NVBUEventHistory Get Method SQL Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2017-12-15 CVE-2017-17412 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2017-17412 7.5 ['Quest'] ['NetVault Backup'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Quest NetVault Backup. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of GET method requests. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to construct SQL queries. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code in the context of the underlying database. Fixed in NVBU 11.4.5 ['2017-12-06 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2017-12-15 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] rgod https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-17-974/
title: Quest NetVault Backup Server Process Manager Service NVBUEventHistory Get Method SQL Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Quest NetVault Backup. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of GET method requests. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to construct SQL queries. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code in the context of the underlying database.
